editorial_decision.distinct_task: Turn an existing photo library or planned shoot into a page specific brief covering visitor purpose, composition, permission, file handover and alternative text.

overlap_review: The homepage content plan decides what the homepage must explain; this article plans the images that support those messages.
The website content ownership article assigns writing and approval responsibilities; this article assigns photo purpose, permission and delivery notes.
The website project brief remains a broader project input; this article supplies a dedicated visual asset worksheet.
limitations: The wording confirms that the question exists but does not establish search demand or commercial value.
No fixed photo count, search ranking, click or enquiry outcome is claimed.
Search visibility, AI citation samples and qualified enquiries remain separate measures.
